raw_sections.experience:
Experience:
Senior Associate -2 State street Corporation Global Billing (Asset Management) (May 05 2025 to May
11 2026)
Key Responsibilities
Responsible in Invoicing Monthly and Quarterly bills for the client services provided, over fund
administration for Ireland Region, which included services like Fund Admin services, Depository services,
Custody Services, Shareholder services and ETF Services.
Timely interaction with various teams like Fund Accounting, Transfer Agent, Custody Team Capital
Markets and derivatives markets to confirm the Month end NAV and Transactions Volume.
Monitoring trade Life cycle of the fund, Fee sechedule, Setup of the fund for billing and Invoicing the
client as per the service provided.
Validating all required documents for billing processes, identifying Discrepancies and proactively resolving
client billing issue to ensure accuracy and timely invoicing.
Timely review Delivery of the Invoices and per the client requirement and meeting deadlines.
Extensively used ORMB Tool, ERP tools, ORACLE for invoicing the clients and handling the issues.
Fund Accountant Level-2 - Apex Fubd Services LLP (February 2022 to April 24 2024)
Responsible in preparation monthly and quarterly NAV for Private Equity funds with primarily working
with E-front application for all the accounting purpose for a largest client EMR Capital.
Key Responsibilities as an Associate 2:
From the primary work beginning from analysis of bank statement from the funds and directing
them to the respective investment and the payments and receipts to the respective books.
Preparation of Bank Analysis from transaction of different currency and Reconciling it to Bank
statements for trade date and Final trade settlement day and wire transfer.
Posting all the Bank entries in E-front and matching all the ledgers to trial balance to match cash
and trade postion reconcilation.
Roll forward and Preparation of NAV (Monthly and quarterly) of all the respective funds, and
checking all the movement with Trial balance.
Work also includes analysis capital call, subscriptions consolidation and calculation of
management fees and carried Interest
Vaishnavi K Ph No: 9177993012 Email: vaishnaviknaik0102@gmail.com Bangalore
Reviewed the financial impact of corporate actions as part of Private Equity fund
accounting and NAV preparation, ensuring accurate accounting treatment and
reconciliation.

Sending capital call notices to investors and moitoring Trade breaks if identified.
Review of the NAV files and above point if Associate 1 has processed the file
Associate level- 2 (Sep 2021- Jan 2022) -KPMG GDC Associate level – 1 (Sep 2019 to August 2021)
To engage in the management of US Engagement teams in the Statutory Audit Practice in the Investment
management Industry, working on the core investment work papers in Private equity funds and hedge
funds in accordance with SEC regulations and US GAAP.
Key Responsibilities as an Associate:
Worked extensively on audit of financial statement of private equity funds, hedge funds and mutual funds
clients in performing substantive audit procedures related to US based investment Companies.

Integral Part of teams assigned as dedicated teams for the US Audit engagement Teams.

Instruct, direct and review the work of Associate in the completion of audit procedure over basic
client accounting.
Understanding and knowledge of industry specific audit procedure.
Knowledge on the structure and hierarchies of private equity funds and hedge funds, master
feeder funds and the role of each entity in the fund structure.
Perform financial audits to ensure that financial statements were fairly presented.
Review and preparation on Reconciliation of Clients general ledger to the trail balance.
Demonstrate the ability to recognize problems and propose relevant solutions, with correct balances.
Review of preparation of Purchase/ sales test work, TB tie outs, financial highlights, Capital
allocation and Capital activity test work.
Review and computation and examination of NAV of funds for Private equities, Derivatives Fixed
Income, Commodities and Custody
Meeting the timeline in processing, submission of the work as per the client requirement.
Audit of fund of funds including confirmation’s and Alternative Finanacial Statements tie outs etc,
Actively engaged with various engagements calls in order to understand the client’s requirements on
execution of work and the timeline on which we need to deliver the work.
To ensure that standard qualities of KPMD GDC are met.
Internships:
Mylan Laboratories Ltd –Bangalore Duration: 2 months
Research project- “A study on the challenges and opportunities faced by the outbound logistics and its
implication on the business”.
Strides Shasun ltd-Bangalore Duration: 2 months:Research project on the organizational study and the
structure and functional management to the finance department at strides ltd.
Achievements and Participations
Competed various linked in training for individual development.
Received Spot award for year 2019 and 2021 for exceptional performance during the audit season at
KPMG.
Was the active member of the Team ‘AMUZZE’ at KPMG which involves in employee engagement
programs.
Won first place on the event of “Entrepreneurship Day”, on the idea called “E-billing, 2018.
Co-authored a research paper titled “An exploratory study on marketing strategies of Human Resource
Management service in India”, on 8th January 2018 at Welingkar Institute of Management Studies
Bangalore.
Participated and own various business quiz and finance events like mock stock.
